case_boundary: Reviewer reasoning only: not executed tests, model outputs, hardcoded production verdicts or measured improvement.
limitations: Prompt-only hypothesis. A short source map does not certify entailment; the unchanged200-character cap may constrain compound explanations. Exact replay49 wire, model response, quality, latency and production mixed-basis behavior require separate receipts. No runner is authorized or executed by this review.
